## What changed

Describe the bounded change.

## Why

Explain the issue and intended outcome.

## Decisions

Identify new or affected methodology decisions.

## Evidence and sources

List relevant source-ledger entries and other evidence.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and their results.

## Traceability impact

Identify affected principles, controls, procedures, artifacts, roles, measures or examples.

## Unresolved questions

List unresolved matters or state `None`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change satisfies the governing issue's acceptance criteria.
- [ ] The change contains no unrelated scope.
- [ ] Terminology and normative language are consistent.
- [ ] Required sources and decisions are recorded.
- [ ] Internal links and identifiers were checked.
- [ ] Mobile readability was checked.
